summary_en: Kakaku.com's board confirmed that Kamgras 1 (backed by Bain Capital and LINE Yahoo) raised its offer price to ¥3,700 per share and extended the offer period to November 26, 2026 (134 business days total). The company is evaluating this offer against a competing ¥3,700-per-share proposal (¥3,720 if KDDI agrees to a non-tender agreement) from the Bain Capital consortium.
title_en: Notice regarding partial amendment to the notice of statement of support and recommendation to apply for public tender offer for the company's shares by Kamgras 1 Co., Ltd.
translation_en_brief:
On November 11, 2026, Kakaku.com announced that Kamgras 1 Co., Ltd. (the tender offeror, backed by Bain Capital Private Equity LP and LINE Yahoo Corporation) has raised its tender offer price from ¥3,683 per share to ¥3,700 per share for ordinary shares and warrants. The offer period has been extended to November 26, 2026, resulting in a total of 134 business days from the original commencement date of May 13, 2026.

The price increase follows a competing proposal from Bain Capital and LINE Yahoo on October 26, 2026, which proposed ¥3,700 per share (or ¥3,720 per share if a non-tender agreement with KDDI is successfully concluded). Kakaku.com's board of directors and special committee established to evaluate the privatization transaction are continuing to assess which offer—the current tender by Kamgras 1 or the alternative proposal—better serves the company's enterprise value and the common interests of shareholders. The board noted that repeated extensions of the Kamgras 1 offer period while the competing proposal remains unstaged are undesirable, and the committee intends to pursue good-faith negotiations with both the tender offeror and the proposing group.

As of the announcement date, the board's position of support for the Kamgras 1 tender and its recommendation that shareholders decide whether to tender remain unchanged from the July 2, 2026 statement.
